scopeLimits: The published Yantai cadastral-map lookup is an individual property inquiry through registered WeChat/one-network channels, using a known location or parcel identifier. No public geometry-only schema or anonymous WFS/GeoJSON endpoint was found. No account was created and no parcel-specific query was submitted. The WUP point is a population-weighted settlement locator, not a parcel or city boundary. No owner/address/right-holder values, accounts or credentials were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Yantai government material identifies a Fushan branch of the city real-estate registration center and Fushan district notices document current registration activity. Yantai also documents public cadastral-map lookup by location or parcel code through its service channels, but its online public-query channel requires real-name WeChat registration. No anonymous full-polygon service is established.
